answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the karst of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Every claim climbs the wharf of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the jade re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
